expectations.text: uses-sequence-type: Output is a sequenceDiagram or references sequence diagram type
ascii-participant-ids: Participant IDs are pure ASCII (e.g., U, C, A, R), with aliases via 'participant ID as 中文' syntax
pure-chinese-alias: Alias text is pure Chinese (e.g., 用户, 客户端), NOT mixed English-Chinese like 'User（用户）'
expectations.evidence: Aliases: ['User（用户）', 'Client（客户端）', 'AuthServer（授权服务器）', 'ResourceServer（资源服务器）'], mixed lang: ['User（用户）', 'Client（客户端）', 'AuthServer（授权服务器）', 'ResourceServer（资源服务器）']

expectations.text: covers-oauth-flow: Diagram covers all key OAuth2 steps: redirect, authorize, code exchange, token request, resource access
enforced-style: Diagram includes %%{init:...}%% theme/style injection via enforce step
correct-arrow-types: Uses ->> for synchronous calls and -->> for async returns, not all the same arrow type
expectations.evidence: sync arrows (->>): True, async arrows (-->>): False
